gen-gf-tektur-gf-noto-sans-hanunoo: Laser-cut sheet metal up top, with strokes of one cutting width. Tektur keeps the outsized lowercase and open curves, while Noto Sans Hanunoo, a sans-serif with easy open terminals, fills the line below.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-noto-sans-syloti-nagri: Noto Sans Syloti Nagri has short ascenders, a tall x-height and an open-bowled a. Noto Sans Syloti Nagri keeps text readable, while Tektur does the showing off with uniform-weight strokes.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-noto-sans-syriac: Tall, rounded lowercase bowls give the text a blown-glass feel, with s shapes turning wide and easy. Noto Sans Syriac follows Tektur, whose strokes skip any pointed-brush swell.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-noto-sans-tai-le: Noto Sans Tai Le reads softly, its ink strokes tapering out before they touch. And Tektur holds every stroke at a single thickness, so the tapering text below feels softer.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-noto-sans-tai-tham: Noto Sans Tai Tham crowds its chalkboard lowercase up toward the capital line. Noto Sans Tai Tham stays quiet and open beside Tektur, whose joins carry full stroke weight.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-noto-sans-tamil: Tektur holds its curves to a drawn-thread thickness, with generous openings at each terminal. Noto Sans Tamil looks magnified without growing, with terminals that stop far from the stem.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-noto-sans-tifinagh: Noto Sans Tifinagh reads round and inviting, its bowls inflated. Tektur draws pipe-cleaner strokes with arches and stems at matching weight, and that tension against rounded bowls is the hook.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-numans: Spaced out and sharp, a look with no stroke contrast at all. Tektur draws uniform strokes while Numans tracks far past normal with swollen lowercase, and that gap between lean and plump is what sticks.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-anek-kannada: Bent-paperclip strokes up top, tube-like and constant in width. Tilt Neon is best at being seen, while Anek Kannada, a sans-serif with a high squared-off x-height, is best at being read.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-blinker: Bold from the first glyph, Tilt Neon draws tube-like strokes of constant width, with a large x-height and short ascenders. Shrink Tilt Neon and Blinker takes over, open and approachable.
